# Task 1 — complete offline

Adopted the existing atomic SQLite lifecycle and closed transition table. Added a persistent authority ID bound into each clip and signed fixture receipt, independent closed receipt validation, rejection of backwards per-channel playback timestamps, and explicit refusal to open an unmigrated prototype database. Approval/export/assembly remain unable to air. Human release affects prompts only; canon always requires air.

Validation: baseline 67 tests passed; task-01-tests.txt records 3 additional passing regressions, including actual process death during a transaction and foreign-database receipt rejection. Receipt issuance is a public offline fixture authority, not authenticated production playback. Production signer selection and trust establishment remain external integration blockers.
